title: Casuals, the Lincoln Theater and the 111 Dance Hall penny dances
summary: Garland says he did not work with Mutt Carey afterwards, then describes the Lincoln Theater and 111 Dance Hall, where ten-cent dances were played from stock arrangements by an eight-piece band.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
